🚀 Big Launches.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Nvidia teams up with data‑center developer Cloverleaf to build next‑gen AI‑optimized facilities, aiming to meet soaring compute demand. Why it matters: Understanding AI hardware infrastructure is crucial for MLOps and systems design roles.

🚀 Big Launches.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Space‑startup Starcloud secures $250 M to launch orbital data centers, targeting low‑latency AI compute as launch capacity dwindles. Why it matters: Introduces a new edge‑compute paradigm that could reshape latency‑critical AI deployments.

🚀 Big Launches.title: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
🚀 Big Launches.summary: LinkedIn rolls out a “Seems like AI slop” button, already used by over a million users to flag AI‑generated content. Why it matters: Demonstrates user‑driven content moderation tools, a growing focus in responsible AI product design.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Nvidia research shows that fine‑tuned “harnesses” (prompt engineering, safety layers) can keep AI agents on task even with modest models. Why it matters: Highlights the interview‑relevant skill of building robust prompt pipelines and safety wrappers for agentic AI.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: TechCrunch reports that Anthropic's Claude models still generate sexually explicit content despite safeguards, raising concerns about content moderation. Why it matters: Underscores the difficulty of building safe LLMs, a hot topic for responsible‑AI interview questions.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice probes Andreessen Horowitz over potential antitrust issues stemming from board overlaps in competing AI firms. Why it matters: Signals increasing regulatory scrutiny of AI investments, relevant for future AI product leaders and policy‑aware engineers.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: Prominent YouTube filmmakers face criticism after accepting sponsorships from AI‑focused companies, sparking debate over transparency and ethics. Why it matters: Highlights reputational risks and the need for ethical partnership guidelines in AI‑related content creation.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: DeepMind showcases 15 years of AI research applied to games, partnering with studios to prototype advanced gameplay agents. Why it matters: Demonstrates real‑world reinforcement‑learning breakthroughs that are likely to appear in interview case studies.

tool_of_day.title: Hugging Face Inference API (Free tier)
tool_of_day.summary: Provides free, rate‑limited access to thousands of open‑source models for rapid prototyping—perfect for student projects and interview demos.

hot_take: As AI safety layers, massive infrastructure deals, and regulatory scrutiny dominate the headlines, mastering both the technical depth and governance awareness of AI is becoming essential for any aspiring AI professional.
